from tslearn.shapelets import LearningShapelets

shp_clf = LearningShapelets(n_shapelets_per_size={3: 2, 4: 1}, max_iter=1, random_state=42)
shp_clf.fit(X, y)

shapelets = shp_clf.shapelets_

assert len(shapelets) == 3, f"Expected 3 shapelets, got {len(shapelets)}"
assert shapelets[0].shape[0] in (3, 4), f"Unexpected shapelet length: {shapelets[0].shape[0]}"

print(f"__CHECK__ shapelets_ {len(shapelets)}")
